en: Sanidassanattika, Āsavāsavagocchakādi (The Triplet on the Visible, etc.; the Group of Fetters and Non-Fetters, etc.)
Dependent on a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, with resistance, and not an outflow (āsava) ... (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are thirty;
under the object condition, nine ... pe ... under the mutuality condition, twenty-five; under the non-disappearance condition, thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, with resistance, and not a fetter (saṃyojana) ... pe ... non-obstructive, non-visible, with resistance ... [and so forth].
Dependent on a state that is not a flood (*no-ogha*) … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is not a bond (*no-yoga*), not visible (*asanidassana*),

and with resistance (*sappaṭigha*) … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is not a bond, not visible, and with resistance … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is not a bond, not visible, with resistance,
and not an hindrance (*no-nīvaraṇa*) … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is not a bond, not visible, with resistance, and not a passion (*no-parāmāsa*) … [abbreviated].
In the case of root condition, thirty; in the case of object condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of mutuality condition, twenty-five ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, thirty.
